details: Diplomatic engagements between US and Iranian envoys have been described as productive, with further talks planned. Concurrently, Saudi Arabia is preparing to resume exports through its East-West pipeline, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has stated that Tehran will persist in pursuing nuclear technology for economic use and may restrict shipping in the Strait of Hormuz if sanctions and a US blockade continue. Brent crude, after a five-session decline, saw slight upward movement overnight.
title: US-Iran Standoff Continues Amid Oil Price Fluctuations

details: Robust US business activity data for September, indicating the fastest expansion in over five years, has heightened expectations for further interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. This development has contributed to a stronger US dollar and higher bond yields, while equity markets and cryptocurrencies have experienced downward pressure. Traders are now pricing in a nearly 70% chance of another Fed rate increase in October, reflecting concerns over tightening monetary policy and its impact on risk assets.
title: Strong US PMIs Bolster Fed Rate Hike Expectations, Crypto Drifts Lower

details: Global markets are closely watching an upcoming high-stakes meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The summit is expected to address several contentious issues, including trade relations, technology, the status of Taiwan, and Iran. Lingering tensions between the two economic superpowers could have significant implications for global economic stability and market sentiment.
title: US-China Summit Approaches, Trade & AI Tensions to be Addressed
